text:
maria: Heads up — Docusaurus build failed on production after #5212 merged. Linkcheck reports a missing fragment for /guides/perf#how-we-scale-prompt-templates but locally the anchors exist. Anyone seen heading wrapping or invisible chars causing slug mismatch?

thomas: Hmm... could be the soft-hyphen / zero-width char introduced during formatting. Prettier/mdx sometimes inserts weird breaks and that changes the slug generation. I ran into a similar issue during the migration.

jin: Quick reproduce steps: run linkcheck locally:

```bash
yarn docs:linkcheck --site=prod --path=/guides/perf
```

Also try normalizing the heading before slugify:

```bash
# strip soft hyphen (U+00AD) and zero-width chars
sed -E "s/[\\u00AD\\u200C\\u200B]//g" docs/guides/perf.md > /tmp/perf.md
node ./scripts/slugify.js /tmp/perf.md
```

ashley: I can open a quick PR to add a normalize step to docs CI and a tiny test. Do we use our slugify or Docusaurus builtin? @thomas?

docs-bot: New PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5421 by ashley — add slug normalization step

thomas: Docusaurus uses its own slugger ("@docusaurus/utils"), but our migration/post-processor runs a legacy slugify for redirects. The mismatch between the two is the likely culprit.

maria: The failing fragment points at an old mkdocs-to-mdx migrated page. Original slugization kept visible hyphens; Docusaurus removes soft-hyphens differently, so the migrated anchor differs. We should either canonicalize anchors during migration or add redirects for backwards compatibility.

jin: Proposed quickfix: run a normalization pass in the migration script to strip soft-hyphens/zw chars and also generate redirect entries. Example redirect snippet to add to the redirects config:

```json
{
  "from": "/guides/perf#how-we-scaleprompt-templates",
  "to": "/guides/perf#how-we-scale-prompt-templates"
}
```

thomas: Also add a lightweight CI job that compares slug outputs from both slugifiers for all headings and fails if there are mismatches > 0. That'll catch regressions before merge.

ashley: I'll update PR #5421 with normalization + a linkcheck comparison job (small matrix). Will request review from @jin and @thomas and ping QA for a quick smoke.

maria: Thanks — that should fix the immediate build break and prevent future drift. If people find other pages with odd wrapping, drop them here and I'll triage. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Docs CI (linkcheck) reported 1 failing fragment. Rerun after PR merge.
